I liked the assembly line analogy, it wasn't too 'baby-talk' and actually helped visualize the memory fragmentation. However, you dropped 'Compiled Graph Fusion' like I should already know exactly how that's implemented under the hood. I get the 'what' (prefix caching), but the 'how' of the fusion part felt a bit like a buzzword until you explained the KV cache part.
